definition: A paycheck is a check that an employer gives to the employee for the payment of wages. The employee may cash the check to receive the money or deposit the check into a bank account. Commonly, paychecks are printed on paper and have a pay stub attached. The pay stub contains detailed information regarding the wage paid by the employer to the employee. A paper paycheck usually contains the following information, which ensures that the money paid through the paycheck is delivered to the correct person:  The name and address of the paying company.  The employee's name and address.  The number of the check.  The amount paid to the employee.  The date of issuance.  The employer's bank routing and account numbers.
